_about: Public-domain Frances Power Cobbe (1822-1904), Irish theist writer, editor of Theodore Parker and campaigner, for the Word Hoard: Thanksgiving, Religious Demands of the Age, Broken Lights, Religious Duty, Studies New and Old, Dawning Lights, Alone to the Alone, Darwinism in Morals, The Hopes of the Human Race, The Duties of Women, and The Peak in Darien. Her books are religious and ethical; her travel and animal-welfare writings are left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 101 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
